openQuestions.q: The 5 missing relatedDocs and 1 missing source file (authority-gate-receipts.ts) all exist on main. Should resolution be git merge main into this story branch before DEV, or cherry-pick individual files? Plan says resolve before source edits but does not prescribe mechanism.
openQuestions.evidence: plan.md baseline precondition paragraph (lines 5-6). git ls on main confirms all 6 files present. Worktree ls confirms absence.
openQuestions.resolution: Resolution: Do not merge the entire dirty main working tree into B-eca1. Before source implementation begins, bring only the scoped baseline required by this story into the story branch: the referenced receipt/gate decision docs and the existing authority-gate-receipts.ts baseline, either by recreating those files with a scoped patch in this worktree or by cherry-picking a future committed baseline that contains only those artifacts. Until that scoped baseline is present, DEV source edits are blocked because verifier/gate code would be implemented without its declared truth docs and helper module.
